Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver

Class LgConfig

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.LgConfig
public class LgConfig extends Object
Old LG Configuration object, now used exclusively in the config file. The System uses PlatformConfig to access the data
